pages.title: Unorithe Sword
pages.text: Take your Phantom Sword to the next level by fusing it with an Unorithe Ingot. The result is a blade with 11 attack damage, a swift attack speed of 2.0 and 3000 uses. A true weapon for those who have mastered the ghostly arts of the phantoms.

pages.title: Recipe
pages.text: Place a Phantom Sword next to an Unorithe Ingot.
